name: Refactor-equivalence proof by symbolic divergence search
description: When a change CLAIMS to be behaviour-preserving, get an EXTERNAL oracle instead of the author's opinion: CrossHair drives Z3 to search for a concrete input where old(x) != new(x), with a Hypothesis differential test as the fallback where symbolic execution cannot proceed. Advisory by construction - it reports a counterexample, it never blocks - and 'no divergence found' is NEVER reported as 'proven equivalent': the report must name the bound the search actually reached.

old_fn_ref.description: Dotted path of the pre-change function

new_fn_ref.description: Dotted path of the post-change function

purity_assertion.description: The caller asserts the pair is pure and deterministic; stage 0 tries to REFUTE this

engine.description: auto tries symbolic first and falls back

search_timeout_seconds.description: The bound that the report must disclose

purity-auditor.description: Tries to refute the caller's purity assertion by reading the pair

equivalence-runner.description: Runs the engines and records the bound each one reached

routes.reason: a wrong purity verdict silently invalidates the whole proof

bound-disclosure.expression: search_bound_recorded == true AND engine_version_recorded == true AND claims_proven_equivalent == false

stages.title: Refute the purity assertion before spending a search

work_unit.title: Try to refute the caller's purity assertion for the function pair
work_unit.question_or_target: Read both functions and their transitive callees and look for I/O, global mutation, clock, random, network, or filesystem-order dependence. An impure pair is REFUSED, never approximated: a symbolic equivalence result on an impure function is meaningless, not merely weaker.

assigned_model_vendor_role.basis: a wrong purity verdict invalidates every downstream result

work_unit.evidence_requirement: each impurity signal cites file:line; a clean verdict lists the callees actually inspected
tests_required: an impure function (reads os.environ) must be REFUSED, not analysed
both-states control: a genuinely pure function must pass, so the refusal is not a blanket reject
work_unit.reviewer_requirement: mechanical gate; the refusal path needs no human sign-off
work_unit.completion_sentinel: SUCCESS:CRV-5101 emitted only when the verdict names every callee inspected and either lists at least one impurity signal with a file:line or asserts purity over an enumerated set; otherwise FAILED:CRV-5101 <reason>
work_unit.retry_policy: no retry - re-reading the same code with the same model is not a second signal
work_unit.mechanism: static read of the call closure for impurity signals

stages.title: CrossHair diffbehavior: search for a divergent input
Differential property test where symbolic execution cannot proceed
No divergence found is not proven equivalent
Emit the counterexample or the bounded no-divergence result

work_unit.title: Emit the equivalence report with its engine, seed, bound and coverage caveat
work_unit.question_or_target: Report either a concrete counterexample input with both outputs, or a NO-DIVERGENCE-WITHIN-BOUND result that states the engine, the engine version, the seed, the wall-clock bound and the paths not explored. The wording 'proven equivalent' is forbidden.

assigned_model_vendor_role.basis: the report is where this blueprint's honesty constraint is enforced

work_unit.evidence_requirement: engine name, engine version, seed and bound are all present, and a counterexample if one exists is re-runnable
tests_required: a refactor with a deliberate off-by-one must yield a concrete counterexample
both-states control: assert the report is REJECTED when it contains the phrase proven equivalent without a bound
work_unit.reviewer_requirement: one reviewer checks that the disclosed bound matches the engine's actual exit reason
work_unit.completion_sentinel: SUCCESS:CRV-5102 emitted only when the report carries engine, version, seed and bound, and either a re-runnable counterexample or an explicit within-bound qualifier; otherwise FAILED:CRV-5102 <reason>
work_unit.retry_policy: two strikes then pivot to reporting UNVERIFIED with the reason the engines could not run
work_unit.mechanism: report assembly with a forbidden-wording check on the equivalence claim

stages.title: This blueprint never blocks a merge
Record the advisory verdict downstream of the bound-disclosure gate

impact.blast_radius: advisory only; writes one report under command-center/review/**

x_extensions.mechanism: Z3-backed search over the input space of two implementations for a witness that they differ. The oracle is a solver, not a test suite and not a reader.
contraindications: NOT for behaviour-CHANGING edits - divergence is the intent there, so a counterexample means nothing
NOT for impure functions (I/O, globals, clock, random, network) - those are REFUSED, not approximated
NOT a blocker: advisory by construction

benchmark_cases.name: deliberate-off-by-one
benchmark_cases.setup: a refactor that shifts a slice bound by one
benchmark_cases.expected: a concrete counterexample input with both outputs

benchmark_cases.name: impure-refusal
benchmark_cases.setup: a function that reads an environment variable
benchmark_cases.expected: REFUSED at the purity gate; a silent analysis here is the failure

x_extensions.why_not_a_duplicate: BP-CRV-05 fixes an over-claimed SENTENCE; this mechanically tests an over-claimed BEHAVIOURAL equivalence. BP-TST-02 also hunts behavioural difference, but it mutates SOURCE and uses the test suite as the oracle; here nothing is mutated and the oracle is a solver.
x_extensions.unverified: UNVERIFIED (roughly-even) that a useful fraction of this estate's Python is pure enough to be addressable; settling experiment = scan the harness for pure functions and report the addressable fraction. Confidence in the MECHANISM is very-likely (80-90%); confidence in its REACH here is roughly-even.

worked_example.name: prove a slug-normaliser rewrite is behaviour-preserving
worked_example.narrative: The purity auditor inspected 4 callees and found no impurity signal. CrossHair ran 120s and exited on its own bound without a witness, so the report reads NO-DIVERGENCE-WITHIN-BOUND(crosshair 0.0.98, seed 20260812, 120s, 3 paths unexplored) - not 'proven equivalent'.

negative_control.why: the exact overclaim this blueprint exists to prevent - an unbounded equivalence claim - must be rejected by the gate
